title: Fact-checking platform
summary: Crowd or AI fact-checking for the internet.
whyItFails: No paying customer. Consumers won't pay. Polarisation. Fact-checkers are distrusted. Scale. Misinformation outpaces checking.

attempts.outcome: Ended in the US; replaced by Community Notes
Still operating; studies found most misleading posts get no note
attempts.notes: Crowd fact-checking launched as Birdwatch; Meta announced a similar system in 2025 to replace fact-checkers.

reasons.detail: No paying customer: Consumers won't pay.
